name: Solano County Housing Authority
description: Section 8 housing vouchers for unincorporated Solano County, Dixon, and Rio Vista
fullDescription: The Solano County Housing Authority (SCHA), managed by the City of Vacaville Housing Authority, runs the Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher program for unincorporated Solano County and the cities of Dixon and Rio Vista.
whatTheyOffer:
- Section 8 Housing Choice Vouchers
- Help paying part of your rent in private-market housing
howToGetIt:
1. Register and join the waiting list through the SCHA Online Portal
2. Must live in unincorporated Solano County, Dixon, or Rio Vista (other Solano cities have their own housing authorities)
3. Must meet income limits
4. When your name reaches the top of the list, eligibility is confirmed
5. Eligible households get a voucher and have 120 days to find qualifying housing
keywords: Solano Housing Authority, SCHA, Section 8, housing voucher, Dixon, Rio Vista, unincorporated Solano, Vacaville, low-income, waitlist
